question: What is the trend in the unit value of Luxembourg's imports from non-EU countries between 2005 and 2025? — projection

limitations.message: Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.
Intra/extra-EU uses the fixed EU27 (2020) composition; the United Kingdom counts as extra-EU throughout.
The projection only extends past patterns. It is not an official forecast and includes no prices, policy or company decisions.
One month (Jan 2019, import) is far above the usual level; spikes like this often come from a few large shipments. It is flagged, not removed.

sql:
SELECT
  period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2002-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
  AND NOT (
    partner_is_eu27_2020 OR (
      partner_is_special AND trade_type = 'intra'
    )
  )
GROUP BY
  period,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: imports: 253.2 M€ Jun 2027
insight: The unit value of Luxembourg's imports from non-EU countries is projected to decrease between 2005 and 2025.
The imports in June 2026 were 309.4 million euros, while the projection for June 2027 is 253.2 million euros, with an 80% confidence interval ranging from 157.7 million to 409.6 million euros.
This projection is based on an additive damped trend with monthly seasonality and has a mean absolute percentage error of 42.5% in back-testing over the last 12 months.
The projection only extends past patterns and does not account for prices, policy, or company decisions, so it is not an official forecast.
Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity, which limits the completeness of the data.
